ideas.title: The Impact of the Funding Freeze on Vulnerable Populations
ideas.description: Investigate the effects of the federal funding freeze on programs and services that support low-income families, immigrants, and other vulnerable groups in Minnesota.
questions: What programs have been affected by the funding freeze?
How are vulnerable populations being impacted?
ideas.insight: I believe that the funding freeze may have disproportionate effects on certain communities, and it's essential to investigate and highlight these impacts to inform policy decisions.
